name: CU_to_first_correct_winner
definition: first step where current_winner equals ground truth; winner only; no stability requirement

name: CU_to_stable_correct_winner
definition: cumulative CU from which the winner stays correct to the end; winner only

name: CU_to_full_decision
definition: full decision stability; sums the quote-based per-step action_cost field

name: decision_stable_CU
definition: full decision stability; ledger-true, from budget_CU minus remaining_budget

name: CU_after_stable_winner
definition: spent_CU minus quantity 2; spend after the WINNER stabilised, not after the full decision
